verdict.why: Locator is now an object rather than a string, so string use of it behaves differently.

draft.detail: Vitest automatically unwraps a Locator to a SerializedLocator object; JSON.stringify(locator) returns a SerializedLocator object.

source.quote: Defined so that `JSON.stringify(locator)` and structured-clone-based transports return a `SerializedLocator` object.
vitest will automatically unwrap it to a SerializedLocator
